// Root Directory: Vercel project's Root Directory MUST be set to `apps/web` in the dashboard (Project → Settings → General → Root Directory). With that set, the working directory for these commands is apps/web, but pnpm install still finds the workspace from the repo root via the lockfile.
// install: Frozen lockfile so a Vercel cache miss can't silently install a different dep version than CI did. `cd ../..` because Vercel runs the install command from the Root Directory (apps/web) but pnpm needs to run at the workspace root so it resolves all packages, then writes a flat node_modules layout that Next.js's build can read.
// build: Build @vivasvana/web AND all its upstream dependencies (config, db). Run from the repo root so turbo can see every workspace package.
// outputDirectory: Relative to the Root Directory (apps/web), so .next IS the build output (not apps/web/.next).
// ignoreCommand: Skip rebuild if neither apps/web nor packages/* changed. `cd ../..` to run git from the repo root. Exit 0 = skip, Exit 1 = build.
ignoreCommand: cd ../.. && git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- apps/web packages || exit 1
